headline: Canucks activate Filip Chytil from IR, expected to return vs. Rangers
take:
Per Daily Faceoff, the Canucks have activated Filip Chytil from injured reserve and expect him back against the Rangers, with defenseman Guillaume Brisebois going on IR in the corresponding move. Chytil was a first-round pick of those same Rangers in 2017, so the return comes against his old club.

Vancouver needs the help. The Canucks are 3-16-1 and have controlled only 39.9 percent of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality), and goaltending has cost them 14.7 goals below what the shots would predict. Chytil has no goals and two assists in seven games so far this season. His own expected goals are 1.15, so a little more finishing is owed. The harder part is that Vancouver has held just 29.02 percent of the 5-on-5 expected goals with him on the ice, about 12.5 points worse than the team's rate without him. Brisebois has the same problem, at 28.81 percent. Chytil's return won't fix this team by itself, and we'd watch whether those on-ice numbers move.
